name: researcher_capture_reference
description: Capture a project attachment once: UTF-8 text, text-bearing PDF, DOCX main body, CSV, JSON or XML. Structured sources normalize values and preserve original byte hash; quote the saved revision rather than original serialization. CSV first-record headers are assumed; DOCX omits layout, images, notes and headers. Recover locators with researcher_source_structure. Reuse operation_key on retry. PDF text preserves page offsets and original byte hash in source provenance; no OCR is performed. Empty-text, encrypted, malformed or over-limit PDFs fail explicitly. Read the captured source before citing; extraction does not verify visual reading order or images.

name: researcher_source_query
description: Semantic paraphrase search inside one saved source using an explicitly prepared offline multilingual model. Returns exact excerpts/offsets, source hash, PDF page numbers, structured unit indices and model/chunk identity after considering the complete bounded source. Scores are cosine similarity, not evidence quality or confidence. Follow next_rank using after_rank; no result proves scientific validity. Missing assets/busy/over-limit work fail explicitly; no remote embedding or lexical fallback is used. Literal researcher_source_search remains available separately.

name: researcher_source_read
description: Read an untrusted source snapshot window and its provenance. Follow next_offset; an unread tail is not absent evidence. PDF provenance records page character offsets, extraction limits and pages without text; do not infer their contents or visual layout. Structured provenance summarizes normalization and unit_count; use researcher_source_structure for paged locators. Cite exact saved text, not guessed OCR or original formatting.

name: researcher_source_search
description: Find exact text inside the full captured source; returns excerpts, offsets and structured unit indices. Recover locators via researcher_source_structure. This is literal search, not semantic validation.

name: researcher_source_structure
description: Read normalized CSV record, JSON pointer, XML expanded path or DOCX body/table paragraph locators with exact saved-text offsets. Follow next_index using after_index until null. Unit indices in search/query results refer here. Not original byte offsets, visual page numbers or proof the whole document was read. Plain text/PDF snapshots may have zero units; PDF pages remain in source_read provenance.
